tests.feature_name: `start`/counter control sequence and `done` generation (critical timing lock)

testpoints.intent: Registered MAC compute and data forwarding across all four cells; array result outputs out1/out2 observed via o_prdata read-back.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: every clock (async active-low reset → 0): `o_result <= (i_data * i_weight) + i_pre_result` (registered)
`o_data_next <= i_data` (registered, forwards data to the next cell)
`o_result <= (i_data * i_weight) + i_pre_result` (registered) — column chain `mac00_out`→`mac_10.i_pre_result`, `mac01_out`→`mac_11.i_pre_result`

testpoints.intent: Partial-sum chaining: top-row seed 32'h0 into i_pre_result and accumulate MSBs.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: The product `i_data * i_weight` is a 32-bit multiply truncated to 32 bits; the accumulate is 32-bit and **wraps** (no saturation).
`i_pre_result = 0` (top-row cells `mac_00`/`mac_01`) → cell acts as a pure multiply into the partial-sum chain.
Negative case: product/sum exceeding 32 bits wraps — accepted by design.
inlined_check_hints.reference_rule: result wraps modulo 2^32; no saturation, no error flag

testpoints.intent: Intentionally-unconnected mac_01/mac_11 o_data_next must not affect results.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `o_data_next <= i_data` (registered) — `mac_01.o_data_next` / `mac_11.o_data_next` intentionally unconnected
inlined_check_hints.reference_rule: output left dangling by design; not a connectivity error

testpoints.intent: Skew alignment: out1=in1 delayed 1 cycle, out2=in2 delayed 2 cycles, staggered wavefront.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `out1` = `in1` delayed **1** cycle (one register `delay10`); `delay10 <= in1`; `out1 = delay10`
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: `delay10` cleared to 0 on async active-low reset (`negedge i_rstn`)

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `out2` = `in2` delayed **2** cycles (two registers `delay20` → `delay21`); `delay20 <= in2`; `delay21 <= delay20`; `out2 = delay21`
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: `delay20` and `delay21` cleared to 0 on async active-low reset (`negedge i_rstn`)

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `out1` = `in1` delayed **1** cycle (one register `delay10`); `out2` = `in2` delayed **2** cycles (two registers `delay20` → `delay21`)
inlined_check_hints.reference_rule: for pair presented at t: out1 valid at t+1, out2 valid at t+2 (out1 leads out2 by 1)
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: both lines restart latency from reset-release edge after `delay10`/`delay20`/`delay21` cleared to 0

testpoints.intent: Async active-low reset clears delay10/delay20/delay21 to 0 mid-stream.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: Async active-low reset clears all skew registers to 0; `delay10`/`delay20`/`delay21` <= 0 on `negedge i_rstn`

testpoints.intent: Write on i_wr & !o_full into mem[wr_addr]; wr_addr advances.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: Write on `i_wr & !o_full` → `mem[wr_addr]`; `wr_addr` advances on the same
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: `mem`, `wr_addr` cleared to 0 on async active-low reset

testpoints.intent: Combinational read o_data=mem[rd_addr]; rd_addr advances on i_rd & !o_empty; FIFO-order sequence.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `rd_addr` advances on `i_rd & !o_empty`
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: `rd_addr` cleared to 0 on async active-low reset

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: Read is **combinational**: `o_data = mem[rd_addr]`
Happy path: write then read returns the written word in FIFO order

testpoints.intent: Flag generation compared directly: o_empty=(wr_addr==rd_addr), o_full=((wr_addr+1)==rd_addr); RM predicts o_full/o_empty per cycle, scoreboard compares against DUT status outputs.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `o_empty = (wr_addr == rd_addr)`
`o_full  = ((wr_addr + 1) == rd_addr)`

testpoints.intent: Write-while-full and read-while-empty are ignored (pointers do not advance).

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `o_full`/`o_empty` use 3-bit pointer wrap (modulo-8); the `(wr_addr+1)==rd_addr` full condition is part of the contract
Write while `o_full` (or read while `o_empty`) is ignored (pointer does not advance)
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: pointers held at reset value until first valid op

testpoints.intent: Async active-low reset clears memory and both pointers to 0.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: Async active-low reset clears memory and both pointers to 0

testpoints.intent: APB weight load to mem[i_paddr]; address map W00=0,W01=1,W10=2,W11=3.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `write_enb = i_psel & i_penable & i_pwrite` → `mem[i_paddr] <= i_pwdata` (clocked, **no reset** on this block — faithful to the reference)
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: NOT reset by `i_rstn`; clocked-only, retains last value

testpoints.intent: APB read returns next result-FIFO word via o_prdata and advances fifo_result read pointer; o_prdata=0 when no read.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `read_enb  = i_psel & i_penable & !i_pwrite` → `o_prdata = fifo_result.o_data` (combinational); otherwise `o_prdata = 0`. The result FIFO read pointer advances on `read_enb` (`fifo_result.i_rd = read_enb`).
inlined_check_hints.reference_rule: read_enb=1 → o_prdata==fifo_result.o_data & i_rd advances rd_addr; read_enb=0 → o_prdata==0
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: regfile block no reset; result-FIFO rd_addr=0 on async reset

testpoints.intent: Counter advance while start asserted, reset to 0 when start deasserted; RM predicts counter per cycle, scoreboard compares against DUT counter output directly.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `counter` (4-bit): async reset → 0; while `start` asserted, increments each clock; when `start` deasserted, resets to 0
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: `counter` cleared to 0 on async active-low reset (`negedge i_rstn`)

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `counter` (4-bit): async reset → 0; while `start` asserted, increments each clock; when `start` deasserted, resets to 0; `done = (counter >= 5)`
inlined_check_hints.reference_rule: re-assert start → counter 0→5, done rises again; drop start mid-pass → counter→0, done==0
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: `counter`=0 on async reset (and on start deassert)

testpoints.intent: fifo_en = start & (counter<2) pop window drives both input FIFO i_rd.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `fifo_en = start & (counter < 2)` (drives `i_rd` of both input FIFOs — pops two elements at the start of a pass)
inlined_check_hints.reset_behavior: counter=0 on async reset → fifo_en follows start gate

testpoints.intent: result_fifo_wr window counter in {2,3,4,5}; routing result_fifo_i_data=out1 at {2,4}, out2 at {3,5}, else 0.

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `result_fifo_wr = (counter ∈ {2,3,4,5})`
`result_fifo_i_data = out1` when `counter ∈ {2,4}`, `= out2` when `counter ∈ {3,5}`, else `0`, where `out1 = mac_10.o_result` and `out2 = mac_11.o_result`
`32'h0` → `mac_00.i_pre_result`, `mac_01.i_pre_result`; `out1 = mac_10.o_result`; `out2 = mac_11.o_result`

testpoints.intent: done = (counter >= 5); RM predicts done per cycle, scoreboard compares against the DUT done status output directly (no longer relies on o_prdata propagation).

inlined_check_hints.implementation_detail: `done = (counter >= 5)`
